formula_or_test: SPFM = 1 - (lambda_F_SPF_residual / lambda_F_SPF), where lambda_F_SPF is the total random-hardware failure rate due to single-point faults and lambda_F_SPF_residual is the residual dangerous single-point fault rate not prevented or detected by safety mechanisms.
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018, Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
volatility: Low; changes only with new ISO 26262 editions

formula_or_test: LFM = 1 - (lambda_F_MPF_lat_residual / lambda_F_MPF_lat), where lambda_F_MPF_lat is the failure rate due to latent multiple-point faults and lambda_F_MPF_lat_residual is the portion of those latent faults not detected by safety mechanisms.
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018, Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
volatility: Low; changes only with new ISO 26262 editions

calculation: ISO 26262-5 probabilistic metric for random hardware failures (PMHF)
formula_or_test: PMHF = lambda_F_residual + lambda_F_MPF_lat, where lambda_F_residual = lambda_F_SPF_residual + lambda_F_MPF_residual. PMHF is an average probability per hour of dangerous random hardware failure; FIT = PMHF * 1e9.
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018, Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
volatility: Low; changes only with new ISO 26262 editions

calculation: ISO 26262-5 ASIL B/C/D hardware metric target test
formula_or_test: For ASIL B: SPFM >= 0.90, LFM >= 0.60, PMHF < 1e-7/h. For ASIL C: SPFM >= 0.97, LFM >= 0.80, PMHF < 1e-7/h. For ASIL D: SPFM >= 0.99, LFM >= 0.90, PMHF < 1e-8/h. Note: ASIL A values omitted here because edition-dependent treatment is less certain.
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018, Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
volatility: Low; changes only with new ISO 26262 editions

calculation: DO-254 design-assurance-level assignment and objective-level mapping
formula_or_test: Map failure-condition effect to design assurance level: catastrophic -> DAL A; hazardous/severe-major -> DAL B; major -> DAL C; minor -> DAL D; no safety effect -> DAL E. The assigned DAL selects the applicable DO-254 hardware design-assurance objectives, with DAL A most stringent and DAL E least stringent.
authority: RTCA DO-254, Design Assurance Guidance for Airborne Electronic Hardware
volatility: Low; standard is stable across revisions

calculation: CHIPS Act advanced manufacturing investment credit amount
formula_or_test: credit_amount = 0.25 * qualified_investment, where qualified_investment is the investment in an advanced manufacturing facility as defined for the credit.
authority: Internal Revenue Code, 26 U.S.C. Section 48D, Advanced manufacturing investment credit, added by CHIPS and Science Act of 2022, Pub. L. 117-167
volatility: Low for the statutory 25 percent rate; interpretive regulations may change

calculation: Export Administration Regulations Total Processing Performance (TPP) for ECCN 3A090-class integrated circuits
formula_or_test: TPP = sum over all processing units i of (MacTOPS_i * effective_bit_length_i), where MacTOPS_i is the peak theoretical performance of processing unit i in millions of operations per second and effective_bit_length_i is the bit length of the operation used to establish that peak performance.
authority: U.S. Export Administration Regulations, 15 CFR part 774, Supplement No. 1, Category 3, ECCN 3A090
volatility: High; export-control thresholds and definitions are amended frequently

calculation: JEDEC FIT-rate point estimate and upper confidence bound from test data
formula_or_test: FIT_point = (r * 1e9) / (sum_j n_j * t_j * AF_j), where r is number of failures, n_j is sample size for stress condition j, t_j is stress hours, and AF_j is acceleration factor to use conditions. Upper confidence bound at confidence level CL: FIT_UCL = (chi_square_quantile(CL, 2r + 2) * 1e9) / (2 * sum_j n_j * t_j * AF_j).
authority: JEDEC JESD74A, Procedure for Calculating Reliability
volatility: Low to moderate; JEDEC standards are revised periodically

calculation: Human Body Model ESD withstand-voltage class
formula_or_test: Given HBM withstand voltage V in volts: Class 0 if V < 250; Class 1A if 250 <= V < 500; Class 1B if 500 <= V < 1000; Class 1C if 1000 <= V < 2000; Class 2 if 2000 <= V < 4000; Class 3A if 4000 <= V < 8000; Class 3B if V >= 8000.
authority: ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001, Human Body Model (HBM) Component Level
volatility: Low to moderate; classification table can change with new joint standard editions

calculation: IEC 61508 safety integrity level target failure measure for continuous or high demand mode
formula_or_test: For dangerous failure rate per hour PFH: SIL 4 if 1e-9 <= PFH < 1e-8; SIL 3 if 1e-8 <= PFH < 1e-7; SIL 2 if 1e-7 <= PFH < 1e-6; SIL 1 if 1e-6 <= PFH < 1e-5.
authority: IEC 61508-1:2010, Functional safety of electrical/electronic/programmable electronic safety-related systems — Part 1: General requirements
